checks.lead: George Noel Gordon Byron, 6th Baron Byron (22 January 1788 – 19 April 1824) was a British poet. He was one of the major figures of the Romantic movement, and is regarded as being among the greatest British poets. Among his best-known works are the lengthy narratives Don Juan and Childe Harold's Pilgrimage; many of his shorter lyrics in Hebrew Melodies also became popular.
